scope.population: All 67 frozen AMD development configurations: 43 safe and 24 seeded hazardous; configurations are not distinct algorithms or newly discovered application bugs.
scope.provenance: Build declarations and clock observations are caller attestations. Hashes bind retained files; they do not independently prove reproducible builds or measurements.
scope.semantics: Original assembly, launch configurations, selected workgroups, output coordinates and mathematical specifications are preserved. Results cover configured workgroups and mathematical-real arithmetic, not inter-workgroup safety or bit-exact floating point.
scope.statistics: Per-case medians and nearest-rank p95; ratios require qualification and all 31 successful measured repeats in both arms. No outlier removal, adaptive retry, cold-cache, CPU-isolation or statistical-significance claim.
scope.timing: Baseline qualification alone selects timing cases; candidate failures remain. First observations are separate from 31 repeated fresh-process rounds. Hazard latency measures parent-observed intended-diagnostic arrival, validated against the complete final graph; safe timing measures process completion without expression export.
scope.validation: Each safe case requires a complete output export and a specification proof over every configured element; intended hazards require a complete graph rejection. Heldouts are not executed or used for prospective validation or tuning.
